release_1_0_1_changes: Documentation, verification and worked-example additions; same MCP and skill runtime bytes.

measurements_including_diagnostics.usage_scope: Maximum cumulative usage per unique native thread, including both preliminary trials and the clean retest. Cache-read input is a subset of inputTokens. Subscription usage, not an invoice.

instrumentation: Official unmodified Hermes CLI and plugin loader; native Codex runtime with process-only isolation settings and a transparent, bounded localhost MCP recorder forwarding actual Veyrul responses. Existing client sign-in; no copied credential or global config edit.
preliminary_runs: Two pre-model CLI launch errors and a numerically successful preliminary use/return pair retained. The latter read unrelated global workstation instructions, so a fresh isolated pair supplies the final evidence.
skill_loader_limit: The native Codex callback requested approval for skill_view under unattended policy. The agent recovered through the five read-only Veyrul tools. This is not proof of universal skill-loader compatibility.
